function HN({ api: e, install: t, publish: n, path: a = "/api/admin/base-map/atlas", decode: o = (r) => createImageBitmap(r) }) {
  let r = null, s = "spring", i = null, l = 0, c = null;
  async function d() {
    if (!r) return;
    const u = r.editorAssets?.seasonAtlases?.[s];
    if (!u || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(u.sha256) || !Number.isSafeInteger(u.byteLength) || u.byteLength < 1 || u.byteLength > 4 * 1024 * 1024) {
      n({ atlasError: "圖集描述無效", atlasLoading: !1 });
      return;
    }
    const b = s + ":" + u.sha256;
    if (i === b) return;
    i = b;

      if (h !== l) return;
      if (p.bytes.length !== u.byteLength || p.sha256 !== u.sha256) throw new Error("圖集長度或摘要不符");
      const v = Array.from(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", p.bytes)), (w) => w.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
      if (h !== l) return;
      if (v !== u.sha256) throw new Error("圖集內容校驗失敗");
      const g = await o(new Blob([p.bytes], { type: "image/png" }));
      if (h !== l) {
        g.close();
        return;
      }
      if (g.width !== 256 || g.height !== 256)
        throw g.close(), new Error("圖集尺寸無效");
      c = g, t(c);
    } catch (p) {
      h === l && (i = null, n({ atlasError: p.message }));
    } finally {
      h === l && n({ atlasLoading: !1 });
    }
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    setSource(u) {
      if (r = u, r) return d();
      l++, i = null, t(null), c?.close(), c = null, n({ atlasLoading: !1, atlasError: "", season: s });
    },

      if (!["spring", "summer", "autumn", "winter"].includes(u)) throw new Error("季節無效");
      return s = u, d();
    },
    retry: d
  });
}

    }), !(!v || !h()) && (c = r({ api: e, work: t, publish: n, confirm: a, gameId: v }), c.setIdentity(s), c.actions.attach(u, b)));
  }
  const p = Object.fromEntries(["reload", "initialize", "stage", "undo", "save", "formDirty", "resize", "pick", "pan", "zoom", "fit", "grid", "locate", "focusDiagnostic", "selectGroup", "layer", "previewMaterial", "previewPlacement", "cancelPlacement", "commitPlacement", "beginObjectMove", "previewObjectMove", "commitObjectMove", "cancelObjectMove", "toggleMulti", "beginMultiMove", "groupSelection", "ungroupSelection", "retryAtlas", "command"].map((v) => [v, (...g) => c?.actions[v](...g)]));
  return p.attach = (v, g) => {
    u = v, b = g, c?.actions.attach(u, b);
  }, p.enter = () => {
    if (!(d || !c))
      return d = !0, c.actions.enter();
  }, Object.freeze({
    actions: Object.freeze(p),
    adoptGame: m,
    canAdoptGame: () => h(),
    selectedGame: () => h() ? l : null,
    canLeave: (v) => c?.canLeave(v) ?? !0,
    dirty: () => c?.dirty() ?? !1,
    render: () => c?.render(),
    setIdentity(v) {
      if (s === v && i === (v?.version ?? null)) {
        c?.setIdentity(v);
        return;
      }
      c?.dispose(), c = null, l = null, s = v, i = v?.version ?? null, m(h() ? o.current() : null), c?.setIdentity(v);
    },
    dispose() {
      c?.dispose(), c = null, u = null, b = null;
    }
  });
}
